::: {.supervision-intro}

**MENTORING · ECOLOGY · RESEARCH TRAINING**

My experience mentoring student research has grown alongside my own work in field ecology and ecological modelling. These projects explore questions about **animal behaviour, species interactions, biological invasions and conservation**, combining field observations and quantitative methods.

<span class="supervision-year">2023 · MASTER'S DISSERTATION</span>

### Preferencias de hábitat de nidificación del abejero europeo (Pernis apivorus) en plantaciones forestales de eucalipto del noroeste de España

**Adrián Remón Elola** · MSc in Ecosystem Restoration · Interuniversity programme: UAH, UCM, URJC and UPM

**My role:** Thesis director; academic tutor: Salvador Rebollo de la Torre.

*Focus:* Multiscale habitat selection and nesting preferences of European honey-buzzards in eucalypt plantations.
:::
::: {.supervision-item}
<span class="supervision-year">2022 · MASTER'S DISSERTATION</span>

### Ecología espacial del abejero europeo Pernis apivorus (Linnaeus, 1758) en Galicia: dominio vital, hábitats de caza y características de los avisperos atacados

**María Hernández García** · MSc in Ecology · Autonomous University of Madrid and Complutense University of Madrid

**My role:** Co-director with Salvador Rebollo de la Torre; academic tutor: Ana Margarida Coelho dos Santos.

*Focus:* GPS telemetry, home ranges, foraging habitats and wasp nests attacked by honey-buzzards.
